what_hurt.educational_guardrail: Review realized outcomes separately from deposits, withdrawals, and unresolved records.

what_hurt.educational_guardrail: Review whether one loss can erase several typical gains before entering a trade.
what_hurt.evidence_strength_reason: largest-loss concentration is computed from opaque grouped high-confidence trades
what_hurt.finding: A small number of losses accounted for a measurable share of gross losses.

what_hurt.educational_guardrail: Define an exit condition before entering a trade and review whether losers stay open longer.
what_hurt.evidence_strength_reason: winner and loser median holding periods are calculated from completed trades
